definitions.root_matching: One-to-one roots in the same physical branch; counts and multiplicity cannot be replaced by residual agreement
definitions.model_scope: P versus independent P, C versus independent C, D versus independent D. Cross-model discrepancies are measured, not required to vanish.

origin: Benchmark numerical criteria. The paper supplies equations, observables and plotted parameters, but does not quote these solver-error bounds or specify the full Fig. 4 normalization.

independent_validation.linear_method: Adaptive Helmholtz cell IVP versus separately implemented midpoint-layer transfer at 4096 and 8192 layers; all 201 reporting points and both paper cases
independent_validation.nonlinear_method: Independent four-component RK45 Stokes integration versus DOP853 Stokes/variational flow for all six cases; independent scalar root solves at all four fixed input sections
independent_validation.branch_resolution: 1025/2049-node local searches followed by 2049/4097-node reference CLI checks; unresolved coarse stationary candidates remain diagnostics until refinement resolves them
independent_validation.limitations: Numerical sensitivity and cross-method agreement, not rigorous error bounds, author Fig. 4 normalization recovery, full native scattering validation or a global uniqueness theorem. No tested submission was used to select these tolerances.
